content: नाडिका .²1 A tubular organ <ab>&c.</ab>; see नाडि. .²2 A Ghaṭikā or 24 minutes; नाडिकाविच्छेदपटहः <ls>Māl. 7</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 3. 11. 8</ls>; <ls>K. 13</ls>, <ls n="K.">70</ls>; दशनाडिकाः पूर्णाः . अतिक्रामति स्नानवेला . <ls>Abhiṣeka. 1</ls>. .²3 A hollow stalk in general. .²4 A fistulous sore. .²5 A ray of the sun. .²6 A gong (on which the hours are struck). .²7 A measure of length = ½ Daṇḍa.
